intent: Loop: Architect-adjustable turn windows and required escalation responses on unblock (#40)
notes: `loop/session.py`: new shared `validate_turn_timeout()` + `TURN_TIMEOUT_MIN/MAX` (30..3600, integral only). Used by CLI unblock, Dashboard start, and Dashboard unblock so the range cannot drift. Default window stays 300s; CLI `start --turn-timeout` intentionally unchanged.

`loop/submit.py` `handle_unblock()`: optional `turn_timeout` persisted to `status.turn_timeout_seconds` inside the session lock before `advance_unblocked()` computes the fresh deadline (applies to this and all later turns; omitted keeps the stored window). Response contract: resolving a pending decision (escalation) requires a message, a response file, or explicit `no_response`; a blank unblock raises before any mutation. Ordinary Architect pause still unblocks with no response. `no_response` is mutually exclusive with message/file and rejected when nothing is pending. Decision response gains `kind` (`message` / `artifact` / `message_and_artifact` / `deliberate_empty`); file-only and deliberate-empty responses surface stable model-facing summaries instead of a blank. `loop_unblocked` event carries `turn_timeout_seconds` (+ `previous_turn_timeout_seconds` and detail suffix when changed) and `response_kind` with `decision_id`.

`loop/cli.py`: `unblock --timeout` (argparse type via the shared validator) and `--no-response`; unblock prints the effective window. Model status/wait text shows `Turn window: Ns (deadline ...)`; status/wait JSON add `turn_timeout_seconds` + `turn_deadline` (additive, `gator-loop-status-v1`). Architect paused view shows the window and states when a response is required.

`gator-dashboard.py`: `_validate_http_turn_timeout()` wraps the shared validator (rejects JSON strings); start uses it; unblock accepts optional `timeout`, `no_response` (bool), maps handler `ValueError` → 400 (nothing written).

`dashboard/views/loop.js` + CSS: Unblock is decision-aware — escalation shows **Response to participant (required)** with Confirm disabled until non-blank; ordinary pause keeps **Message (optional)**. New Turn window (s) input defaults to the session's current value and is sent only when changed. `pollLoop()` no longer re-renders while a control input is open (the 3 s poll was wiping typed messages — pre-existing, now load-bearing for required responses).

Tests: `TestValidateTurnTimeout`, `TestUnblockTurnWindow`, `TestUnblockResponseContract` (handler + CLI); Dashboard endpoint tests for blank-rejection-without-write, message / no_response ledger results, pause without response, timeout persistence + deadline, invalid timeouts without write, start default 300; Playwright UI tests for required label/disabled Confirm/no blank POST, optional pause + timeout send, and poll-does-not-wipe. Two existing tests updated to the new contract (escalation unblock now supplies a message; blank-unblock test now uses an ordinary pause).

Charters: `scripts-loop.md` (`validate_turn_timeout`, `handle_unblock`, `advance_unblocked`, `_cmd_unblock`, status/wait turn window), `scripts-dashboard.md` (unblock contract, `_validate_http_turn_timeout`), `scripts-dashboard-ui.md` (decision-aware unblock, timeout input, compose guard).
